design_fields.q2_rationale: The study explicitly states that it did not use sampling weights, treating the dataset as a real-world learner log rather than a nationally representative survey.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study does not analyze student-level survey data where schools are the sampling unit, as it uses a log dataset from a tutoring system.
design_fields.q4_rationale: There is no mention of any validation strategy such as cross-validation or external validation in the provided excerpts.
